extension.summary: Coloured logos of video game publishers
extension.description: Logos of the companies that publish video games, for skins to show beside a game. Named as the game library names each company, and drawn to read on a dark background.
extension.news: [B]v0.0.2[/B][CR]49 more publishers, among them Ocean, Codemasters, Interplay, Enix, Square and Sierra.[CR][B]v0.0.1[/B][CR]50 publishers, the most common in a large library.
